title: Spark 4B fine-tune writes Blender Python that builds geometry for 100 of 100 BlendNet prompts
summary: A community fine-tune of the 4B Spark model turns object requests into Blender Python scripts; the author reports all 100 BlendNet scripts built geometry and 20 of 50 on 3DCode, while noting that running is not the same as visual quality.
